# Load Libraries
```{r}
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(paletteer)
```

```{r}
project_palette <- paletteer_d("calecopal::superbloom1")

capture <- read.csv("Data/capture_cleaned.csv")

capture$season <- as.factor(capture$season)
capture$sex <- as.factor(capture$sex)
capture$site <- as.factor(capture$site)
capture$region <- as.factor(capture$region)
```


```{r}
ui <- dashboardPage(
  
dashboardHeader(title = "🦇 Bat Capture Analysis 🦇", titleWidth = 350),

dashboardSidebar(
sidebarMenu(
menuItem("Season Analysis 🍂", tabName = "season"),
menuItem("Sex Analysis ⚧️", tabName = "sex"),
menuItem("Region Analysis 🌎", tabName = "region"),
menuItem("Morphological Scaling 📏", tabName = "scaling"),
menuItem("Captur`e Map 📍", tabName = "map")
)),

dashboardBody(

  tags$head(
  tags$style(HTML(".main-header .logo {background-color: #5D9D61 !important;color: white !important;}
                  .main-header .navbar {background-color: #5D9D61 !important;}
                  .sidebar-menu > li > a:hover {
    border-left-color: #5D9D61 !important;
  }.sidebar-menu > li.active > a {
    border-left-color: #5D9D61 !important;
  }"))
),

tabItems(

# ---------------- SEASON ----------------
tabItem(tabName = "season",
fluidRow(

  box(width=4,
  selectInput("season_y","Variable",
  choices=c("Forearm Length"="forearm",
  "Ear Length"="ear",
  "Mass"="mass"))
),

box(width=8,
  plotOutput("season_plot"),
  verbatimTextOutput("season_text"))
)),

# ---------------- SEX ----------------
tabItem(tabName = "sex",
fluidRow(

  box(width=4,
  selectInput("sex_y","Variable",
  choices=c("Forearm Length"="forearm",
  "Ear Length"="ear",
  "Mass"="mass"))
),

box(width=8,
  plotOutput("sex_plot"),
  verbatimTextOutput("sex_text"))
)),

# ---------------- REGION ----------------
tabItem(tabName = "region",
fluidRow(

box(width=4,
  selectInput("region_y","Variable",
  choices=c("Forearm Length"="forearm",
  "Ear Length"="ear",
  "Mass"="mass"))
),

box(width=8,
  plotOutput("region_plot"),
  verbatimTextOutput("region_text"))
)),

# ---------------- SCALING ----------------
tabItem(tabName = "scaling",
fluidRow(

box(width=4,

  selectInput("x_var","X Variable",
  choices=c("Forearm Length"="forearm",
  "Ear Length"="ear")),

selectInput("y_var","Y Variable",
  choices=c("Mass"="mass",
  "Ear Length"="ear",
  "Forearm Length"="forearm"))

),

box(width=8,
  plotOutput("scaling_plot"),
  verbatimTextOutput("scaling_text"))
)),

# ---------------- MAP ----------------
tabItem(tabName="map",
fluidRow(
  box(width=12,
  leafletOutput("capture_map",height=600))
))

)))
server <- function(input, output) {

# -------- SEASON PLOT --------
output$season_plot <- renderPlot({

ggplot(capture,
aes(x=season,
y=.data[[input$season_y]],
fill=season))+

geom_boxplot(alpha=.8)+

scale_fill_manual(values=project_palette)+

theme_minimal()+
labs(y=input$season_y,x="Season")

})

output$season_text <- renderPrint({

model <- aov(
as.formula(paste(input$season_y,"~ season")),
data=capture)

result <- summary(model)

print(result)

p <- result[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]

if(p < .05){
cat("\nSignificant seasonal differences detected (p <",p,")")
}else{
cat("\nNo significant seasonal differences detected (p =",p,")")
}

})


# -------- SEX PLOT --------
output$sex_plot <- renderPlot({

ggplot(capture,
aes(x=sex,
y=.data[[input$sex_y]],
fill=sex))+

geom_boxplot(alpha=.8)+

scale_fill_manual(values=project_palette)+

theme_minimal()

})

output$sex_text <- renderPrint({

test <- t.test(
as.formula(paste(input$sex_y,"~ sex")),
data=capture)

print(test)

if(test$p.value < .05){
cat("\nSignificant difference between sexes.")
}else{
cat("\nNo significant difference between sexes.")
}

})


# -------- REGION PLOT --------
output$region_plot <- renderPlot({

ggplot(capture,
aes(x=region,
y=.data[[input$region_y]],
fill=region))+

geom_boxplot(alpha=.8)+

scale_fill_manual(values=project_palette)+

theme_minimal()+
theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))

})

output$region_text <- renderPrint({

model <- aov(
as.formula(paste(input$region_y,"~ region")),
data=capture)

result <- summary(model)

print(result)

p <- result[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]

if(p < .05){
cat("\nSignificant regional differences detected.")
}else{
cat("\nNo significant regional differences detected.")
}

})


# -------- SCALING --------
output$scaling_plot <- renderPlot({

ggplot(capture,
aes(x=.data[[input$x_var]],
y=.data[[input$y_var]]))+

geom_point(color=project_palette[4],alpha=.7,size=2)+

geom_smooth(method="lm",color="black",se=TRUE)+

theme_minimal()+

labs(x=input$x_var,y=input$y_var)

})

output$scaling_text <- renderPrint({

model <- lm(
as.formula(paste(input$y_var,"~",input$x_var)),
data=capture)

summary_model <- summary(model)

print(summary_model)

cat("\nRegression Equation:\n")

coef <- coefficients(model)

cat(input$y_var,"=",
round(coef[1],3),"+",
round(coef[2],3),"*",input$x_var,"\n")

cat("\nR-squared:",round(summary_model$r.squared,3))

})


# -------- MAP --------
output$capture_map <- renderLeaflet({

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = as.character(project_palette),
  domain = capture$season
)

leaflet(data = capture) |>

addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Voyager) |>

addCircleMarkers(
  lng = ~lon,
  lat = ~lat,
  
  radius = ~mass/3,   # scale by bat mass
  
  color = ~pal(season),
  fillOpacity = 0.85,
  stroke = TRUE,
  weight = 1,
  
  label = ~paste0(
    site, " (", season, ")"
  ),
  
  popup = ~paste0(
    "<b>Site:</b> ", site,
    "<br><b>Region:</b> ", region,
    "<br><b>Season:</b> ", season,
    "<br><b>Mass:</b> ", mass, " g",
    "<br><b>Forearm:</b> ", forearm, " mm",
    "<br><b>Ear:</b> ", ear, " mm"
  ),
  
  clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions()
) |>

addLegend(
  "bottomright",
  pal = pal,
  values = ~season,
  title = "Season"
)

})

}

shinyApp(ui,server)
```
